subject: Multi Tag Problem
author: ZombieTron
body:
I have (at least) 3 friends on my friends list who have more than one tag, and I have both or all 3 of their tags on my friends list. This could easily create problems on Paradise as the scores you are trying to beat are your friends scores. Xandu could have 3 higher scores than me on various tags, it could make things a bit more challenging!

Other than creating BurnoutAholics & BurnoutAholic tags I really don't see the point of me racing under a different name. If you don't want your friends to race you, you can always change your status to offline. 

 --- The Original and the Best ---

subject: 2 is fair
author: BootlegGiant
body:
2 tags I can understand, heck, even I have 2, one for racing friends and one for when I am not a happy bunny

one more point for me

subject: A Reason For Another Tag.
author: ichienkai
body:
Sometimes dude, particularly when i am tired or have had  too much alcohol - i might not want to talk to people during races, i wanna play music very loud and turn down the xbox sound.  Or for that matter, in a complete state of drunkenness where i can see 3 revenge racers on the track on my tv and the rest of the racers are 3 miles ahead and laughing at me, but i still wanna race knowing i dont stand a chance and the only rooms open are ranked? Then thats when another tag comes in handy.... 

Another reason again because of the loud music/xbox sound turned low is that your friends know that you are playing and will invite you or jump in a room you are in and its ignorant to be sat there with your music blasting and no speech.  If im on a secret or new tag then i dont have invites or my friends room hopping - i can race ranked when i want - last night when all the regulars had gone and i wasnt ready to go i got a Grrrrr tag out and jumped in a German hosted room.  Usually its a no-no just because a lot of German AND French Burners are in the 4000-1000 bracket but have much lower skills/laptimes and are very very competitive, i only just manage to win usually and gain no rank from playings these guys. Dont know what was wrong with this little group last night but i won the whole races and for some reason 3 of them thought i was a girl (Grrrrr Baby = Chick??) And i thought that was funny, 3 friends request later and much begging for the chick to talk (ROFL).

 So there are two of my reasons for tags Boot - i admit my 4 have jammed up the ranks and thats one reason i dont  think people should have 20 tags. But there will be no Rank system in Paradise dude, so it wont matter so much on Burnout anymore for Burners to be multi schizo with identitys
